## What's new since v6.1.6-pre.3

### Fixed

- **DNS recording without root can no longer be turned on while ad blocking is off.** Without root, only the ad-blocking VPN sees DNS requests, so the recording showed as running while recording nothing. Now the record button is greyed out while the VPN is off, the screen says to turn ad blocking on, and pressing it explains why. Turning ad blocking off also ends a recording.

Everything in [v6.1.6-pre.3](https://github.com/bushman74/AdAway-but-Monet/releases/tag/v6.1.6-pre.3) is included.
